visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a real-life man in a white baseball cap and black shorts standing in front of a poolside artificial waterfall. Water splashes vigorously against his back and the ground. Yellow and white text overlays dominate the upper and lower thirds of the screen. (2) The scene transitions to a 2D animation style with a black background. A red stick-figure character representing Donald Thomson appears, wearing a tie. A cartoon television screen shows a similar figure, while a purple-tinted character looking distressed is shown on the side, representing a victim. (3) Historical black and white photographs of a young man, Martin Tankleff, are presented. He is wearing a suit and tie. Cartoon drawings of police officers in yellow outlines are superimposed near the photos. The background shifts to a collage of newspaper-like textures and courtroom-themed imagery. (4) A color photograph of a family including Paul Ingram is shown. It then transitions to a cartoon animation of Paul in handcuffs being interrogated by a police officer. Legal-style documents with red 'Good Health' seals appear on screen. The final shot of this phase shows the cartoon character behind vertical prison bars in an orange uniform. (5) A final animated sequence features a young woman with long light-brown hair and a pink hairclip looking directly at the camera. A large red arrow points downward toward a caption area. The logo of the creator is visible in the top left corner.
